title: calycera leucanthema
intro: Calycera leucanthema, commonly known as the white daisy, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Calyceraceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in treating various health issues such as wounds, fever, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Calycera leucanthema include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, making it a valuable herb in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
